headword: {舌先三寸|したさきさんずん}

definitions.explanation: Clever, persuasive talk with nothing real behind it, used to win someone over or talk one's way out of trouble. Literally "three sun (about 9 cm) of the tip of the tongue."

examples.japanese: {舌先三寸|したさきさんずん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{丸|まる}め{込|こ}まれた→丸め込む：32113_marumekomu⟧。
examples.english: I was talked round with smooth talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{舌先三寸|したさきさんずん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧きた。
examples.english: He has made his way in life on the strength of a glib tongue.

examples.japanese: {舌先三寸|したさきさんずん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧トーク⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧だまされて、⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧しまった。
examples.english: Taken in by a slick sales pitch, I ended up signing up for expensive insurance.

notes:
Always critical: the speaker suggests the words are clever but empty or deceptive.
